title: NAS security mode command not accepted by the UE

entities.name: SECURITY MODE REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by the UE when it cannot accept the security mode command. Contains an EMM cause indicating rejection reason.

entities.name: EMM cause
entities.description: Information element in SECURITY MODE REJECT message indicating rejection reason. Common values include #23 (UE security capabilities mismatch) and #24 (security mode rejected, unspecified).

entities.name: Timer T3460
entities.description: Timer running in MME during NAS security mode control procedure. Stopped upon receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT message.

entities.name: NAS security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure triggered to establish NAS security. Aborted by MME upon receiving SECURITY MODE REJECT message.

entities.name: EPS security context in use before initiation
entities.description: Security context that was active before NAS security mode control procedure started. Reapplied by both UE and MME after procedure abort.

entities.name: UE security capabilities mismatch
entities.description: Condition where UE security capabilities do not match network requirements, indicated by EMM cause #23.

entities.name: Security mode rejected, unspecified
entities.description: Unspecified rejection reason for security mode command, indicated by EMM cause #24.

relations.description: SECURITY MODE REJECT message contains EMM cause IE indicating rejection reason.
EMM cause value #23 indicates UE security capabilities mismatch condition.
EMM cause value #24 indicates unspecified security mode rejection condition.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT message stops timer T3460 in MME.
Receipt of SECURITY MODE REJECT message triggers MME to abort the NAS security mode control procedure.
After SECURITY MODE REJECT, both UE and MME reapply the EPS security context in use before procedure initiation.
SECURITY MODE REJECT message is protected using the EPS security context in use before procedure initiation.
